name: moonlit-forest-workshop
prompt: For EXISTING original moonlit-forest-workshop, produce a separate, reusable ORIGINAL BLENDER forest environment asset collection (not WPF proxies and not imported/downloaded third-party assets). Use real Blender mesh geometry with sensible topology, separate named editable objects/collections for (1) distinct rugged tree trunks, (2) tapered branching trees with visible limbs, (3) individual canopy foliage clusters, (4) clumped grasses, (5) low moss patches, and (6) winding uneven woodland terrain/path. Moonlit, subtly gothic forest, varied silhouettes and muted blue-green/brown PBR materials. Maintain distinct meshes and materials so each item can be imported or modified independently later; preserve the existing native Foundry stone kit unchanged. Save editable .blend, PNG preview render, QA/geometry report, and validated glTF/GLB exports under this project's assets folder if the worker supports it. Record generating Blender engine, export verification and provenance in receipt; do not claim unsupported deliverables.
